$comment: GnuCOBOL 3.2's claims as measured on cobc 3.2.0 under WSL (DESIGN-conformance-suite.md §4, §5): no 2023
dialect. The modules are the two whose syntax cobc translates at -std=cobol2002 and -std=cobol2014 (a
Report Writer RD with INITIATE/GENERATE/TERMINATE; a SCREEN SECTION); the file sharing clauses of A.4.7 are a
syntax error there (EXCLUSIVE is no reserved word of those dialects). The elements are the core facilities
cobc translates; the S3 pilot (kb/Work PB3178) verifies every claim against its recorded baseline. The A.1
values were measured: format 3 of the RECORD clause wrote a 2-character record of a 2-TO-10 file as 6 bytes
(a 4-byte length prefix and the record: variable-length), and the turn-location-unspecified test printed
LOCATION AVAILABLE at -std=cobol2002 and -std=cobol2014. The extra reserved words are, per dialect, the
words `cobc --list-reserved -std=<dialect>` lists that reserved-words.json does not reserve at that edition.
